name: v0.3.8 — Profile Guac-AI tiles → horizontal scroll
releaseNotes:
• Profile screen 'Your Guac-AI' 5×2 pill grid is now one horizontal-scroll row (Worth It? · GuacScore · Inbox · GuacWizard · Rewards · Stash · Steals · Car Miles · How It Works). Drops half the vertical scroll on Profile.
